summary: National Fuel Gas Co filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed note offering of three series of unsecured notes, the proceeds of which will partly fund the 'CenterPoint Acquisition' and general corporate purposes, including repurchasing or redeeming outstanding 2026 notes. The notes feature interest rate adjustments, optional redemption, change-of-control put, and a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the acquisition is not completed by the outside date or if the purchase agreement is terminated. The offering is underwritten by TD Securities and Wells Fargo. No specific deal terms (price, size, maturity) are finalized in this preliminary document. The filing represents a routine debt capital markets transaction rather than a special situation event.
